summary: Reach visual controls with your screen reader.
audience: Blind and low-vision people using remote desktops, legacy dialogs, or canvas applications with missing accessibility controls.
job_to_be_done: Turn a user-selected visual screen region into local numbered text and boundary targets that can be heard with a screen reader.
constraints: Capture and OCR stay local by default.
The app does not control another computer or replace a screen reader.
Offer a one-click isolated sample demo and offline use after the first visit.
